home.heroTitle: Every gathering, every language, one platform

home.noEvents: No published events yet. Check back soon.

wizard.typeCountHelp: Choose how many people you are registering in each category.
wizard.successBody: You can see the status of every participant below.
wizard.submitError: Something went wrong while submitting. Your answers are saved on this device — please try again.
wizard.modeTitle: Is this a single or a group registration?
wizard.modeHelp: You can register just yourself, or several people at once.
wizard.modeSingleHelp: I'm registering only one participant (e.g. myself).
wizard.modeFamilyHelp: I'm registering a group (e.g. my family).
wizard.noModeSelected: Choose a registration type to continue.
wizard.singleTypeTitle: What type of participant are you?
wizard.singleTypeHelp: Pick the option that describes you.
wizard.alreadyRegistered: You have already registered for this event. You can review or edit your registration while registration is open.
wizard.registrationClosed: Registration for this event is closed.
wizard.noTypesAvailable: Registration for this event is by invitation only. Use the link your organizer sent you.

validation.notAnOption: Choose one of the listed options

myRegs.title: My registrations
myRegs.empty: You have not registered for any events yet.
myRegs.cancelConfirm: Cancel {name}? A waitlisted participant may take this spot.

console.adminPurgeWarning: This erases these registrations and all their answers from the database. It cannot be undone and they cannot be restored.
console.adminPurgeNeedsCancelled: On a live event only cancelled registrations can be permanently deleted. Set the ones below to Cancelled first, or archive the event.
console.adminPurgeError: Could not delete. Please try again.
console.adminPurgeEventHelp: Erase this event and everything on it from the database. This cannot be undone.
console.adminPurgeEventBlocked: This event can only be permanently deleted once it has ended, or after it has been archived.
console.adminPurgeEventWarning: This erases the event, its forms, its participant types and all {count} registrations from the database. It cannot be undone and nothing can be restored.
console.adminPurgeEventError: Could not delete the event. Please try again.
console.adminViewOnly: View only. To change anything about this event, use the Events Hub.
console.adminArchivedEventsIntro: Events and registrations that are hidden everywhere else. View only — editing belongs in the Events Hub.
console.adminTranslationsIntro: Mosaic's own interface text — buttons, field labels, error messages — machine-translated once per organizer-added language and shared by every event. Refresh after the platform adds new text.
console.trNoKey: No translation API key is configured, so nothing can be translated.
console.trRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and refresh the rest.
console.trNoLanguages: No organizer has added a language beyond the five Mosaic ships with, so there is nothing to translate.
console.trPlatformNote: The five built-in languages are translated by hand and are never listed here.
console.archiveParticipantWarning: This hides all information from everyone — including the registrant — but keeps it in the database as archive history. To remove a registration without hiding its information, change its status instead.
console.archiveParticipantError: Could not archive. Please try again.
console.archiveNeedsCancelled: Only cancelled registrations can be archived. Set the ones below to Cancelled first.
console.title: Events Hub
console.noAccess: You do not have organizer access. Contact an administrator.
console.capacityHelp: Leave empty for unlimited. Once it is full, further registrations join the waitlist and are confirmed automatically when someone cancels.
console.typeCapacityHelp: A type’s capacity is counted separately from the event’s — whichever fills first sends the next registration to the waitlist. Leave one empty for unlimited.
console.previewHint: This is a preview — answers are not saved.
console.noParticipants: No participants match the current filters.
console.createError: Something went wrong creating the event. Please try again.
console.createNoAccess: Your account does not have permission to create events. Ask an administrator to grant you organizer access.
console.createDateError: The end date must be after the start date.
console.contactHelp: Shown publicly on the event page.
console.selectTypeHelp: Add a participant type from the list below, or create your own.
console.adminUsersHelp: Admins manage everything, including this console. Global organizers can manage every event. Anyone can create their own events.
console.transferConfirm: Transfer super admin to {name}? You will become a regular admin.
console.levelViewDesc: View and export registrations and payments.
console.levelScholarshipDesc: View, plus manage and add scholarships.
console.levelCheckinDesc: Scholarship, plus add registrants and edit, add or delete payments.
console.levelUpdateDesc: Check-in, plus change the event and its questions, and delete registrants.
console.levelFullDesc: Can do everything, including managing the team.
console.requestRoleTitle: Want to help manage all events?
console.requestRoleIntro: Global organizers can view and manage every event. Request the role and an administrator will review it.
console.rolesHelp: What each role allows. Standard roles can have their privileges turned on or off but cannot be renamed or deleted; custom roles are fully editable while unused.
console.customRolesEventHelp: Define roles available only on this event. Roles marked “All events” are managed from the admin console.
console.roleInUse: This role is still assigned to at least one team member.
console.saveFailed: Saving failed — your latest changes are not stored
console.publishFailed: Publishing failed — the form was not published
console.loadError: Could not load participants. Adjust your search or try again.
console.newFormError: Could not create the form. Please try again.
console.formModeSingleHelp: Shown when a respondent registers only themself.
console.formModeFamilyHelp: Shown when a respondent registers a group.
console.copyQuestionsHelp: Reuse the questions of an existing form so you don't have to rebuild them.
console.publishNeedsQuestion: A form must include at least one question
console.noMyEvents: You're not part of any events yet. Create one, or request to join an event below.
console.addByEmailHelp: Grant a global role by email. If they haven't signed in to Mosaic yet, they'll be invited and the role applied on their first sign-in.
console.roleGranted: Role granted. A notification email is on its way.
console.inviteSentPending: Invitation sent. The role will be applied automatically when they first sign in.
console.inviteRecordedNoEmail: Invitation recorded, but the notification email couldn't be sent. Check the SMTP settings.
console.roleGrantedNoEmail: Role granted, but the notification email couldn't be sent. Check the SMTP settings.
console.eventCodeHelp: Share this code so people can request to join this event.
console.joinEventsHelp: You can request access to organize or view other events in this organization.
console.joinEventsAllAccess: You have admin access and can view all events.
console.joinEventsEmpty: There are no other active events to join.
console.joinByCodeHelp: Enter the event's slug/code (e.g. summer-conference-2026) to request organizer access.
console.defaultFormTip: This form is used when no matching single or group response form exists.
console.visibilityHelp: Unlisted events don't appear on the public list — only people with the link can open them.
console.visibilityPublic: Public — shown on the home page
console.archiveEventWarning: This hides the event from everyone — including you — but keeps it in the database as archive history. An admin can find it under Archived Events.
console.archiveEventError: Could not archive the event. Please try again.
console.draftNote: This event is a draft — the public page goes live when you publish it.
console.unsavedBody: You have changes that haven't been saved. If you leave this page now, they will be lost.
console.unpublishedBody: Your edits are saved as a draft, but the live registration form still shows the previously published version. Publish now to make them take effect.
console.heading: Heading
console.coverHelp: Shown as the hero background at the top of the page.
console.heroDescriptionHelp: Short intro shown in the hero, under the title.
console.tierFeaturesHelp: One item per line in "What's included".
console.uploadBadType: Unsupported file type. Use JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF.
console.uploadTooLarge: Image is too large. Maximum size is 5 MB.
console.langSwitcherHelp: Left unset, the switcher tints itself from your hero text so it stays readable over any cover image. Setting the text colour alone also tints its background and border.
console.statsHelp: Short highlights shown in the About section, e.g. “50+” and “Workshops”.
console.applyToAllTitles: Apply This Color To All Section Titles
console.countdownHelp: Counts down to the event start date, shown next to the button.
console.mapEmbedHelp: Paste any Google Maps link, or leave empty to use the address above.
console.sectionOrderHelp: Reorder how sections appear on the page. The hero always stays on top.
console.testimonialHeadingHelp: The heading is optional — leave it empty to show only the quotes.
console.countdownPastHelp: If the chosen date is already in the past, the countdown hides itself — pick a future one (e.g. event end).
console.videoUrl: Video URL (YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive or .mp4)
console.videoHelp: Paste a video link — it shows instead of the image.
console.heroOpacityHelp: Tints the cover image. With no image the color fills the hero solid.
console.pagePreviewHint: This is the page as attendees see it. Hover a section and click the pencil to edit it.
console.slugHelp: Used in the event's public link. Changing it breaks the old link.
console.slugWarnBody: The public link will change from “/events/{old}” to “/events/{next}”. Anyone with the old link — flyers, emails, messages already shared — will no longer reach this event. Continue?
console.langWarnBody: Removing {langs} permanently deletes every text translated into it — on the event page, the registration forms and the participant types. Adding the language back later means translating everything again.
console.dateFormatHint: Dates are shown to each person in their own preferred date format (set in their profile).
console.publishNeedsForm: Publish at least one form before publishing the event.
console.primaryColorHelp: The primary color paints buttons, links, highlights and section accents.
console.contrastWarning: Low contrast ({ratio}:1). Text may be hard to read — aim for 4.5:1 or higher.
console.fontScopeHelp: These apply to the whole page. To change one section only, edit it in that section's tab.
console.faviconHelp: The small icon shown in the browser tab.
console.availableLanguagesHelp: Visitors can switch between the languages you enable here.
console.translateNoChanges: No fields have changed since the last translation, so there is nothing to translate. Edit your default-language text first, or use “Translate all fields” to redo everything.
console.translateAllTooltip: Retranslates every field in every language, replacing translations you typed yourself. To translate only the fields you've changed, just switch the language instead — that happens automatically.
console.ariaLanguageHint: Switching language translates any fields you've changed since the last translation
console.translateAllHelp: Translates only the fields you've edited since the last translation, plus any language that has no translations yet. Text you typed yourself is never touched.
console.autoTranslateHelp: Switching to another language translates what changed since last time — everything on the first switch, then only fields you've edited. Anything you typed yourself is kept.
console.translateDone: Translated. Review the other languages, then Save Page.
console.translateDoneForm: Translated. Review each language in the question tabs — changes autosave.
console.translateNoKey: Auto-translation isn't set up yet (missing API key). Ask your admin to add GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY.
console.translateNoTargets: Enable at least one other language first.
console.translateNothing: Nothing to translate yet — add some text first.
console.translateUpToDate: Nothing to translate — every language already matches your current default-language text.
console.translateForceHelp: Retranslates every field from scratch in every language, replacing translations you typed yourself. Use it to start over.
console.translateForceConfirm:
Retranslate every field in every language?

This replaces ALL existing translations, including any you wrote or corrected by hand. That cannot be undone.
console.translateForceNoChangesConfirm:
No fields have changed since the last translation, so nothing needs updating.

Retranslate every field anyway? This replaces ALL existing translations, including any you wrote or corrected by hand. That cannot be undone.
console.customLanguageHelp: Custom languages are translated automatically — the event’s own text and the platform’s buttons and labels alike. Review or adjust any of it in the event page editor.
console.addLanguagesInSettings: Add or manage languages in Settings
console.languagesHelp: Choose which languages this event and its registration form are offered in. Attendees can switch between them; the default is used when a translation is missing.
console.defaultLanguageHelp: Used as a fallback wherever a translation is missing.
console.defaultLanguageNeedsName: Add the event name in that language on the Event Page tab before making it the default.
console.translateSourceUnsupported: Auto-translate needs the default language to be English, Spanish, French, Russian or Ukrainian.
console.imageSideHelp: Which side the cover image sits on in the split layout.
console.inspectorEmpty: Select a question to edit it.
console.openForAnswers: Open a registration to see every answer.
console.acceptedFileTypesHelp: Comma-separated extensions, e.g. pdf, jpg, png. Leave empty to allow any type.
console.validationRangeWarning: The minimum is greater than the maximum, so no answer can pass.
console.closeRegistrationNowHelp: Stops new registrations immediately, whatever the dates say. Uncheck to reopen.
console.adminOnlyHelp: Hidden from the registration form. Only organizers can see and fill this in, from the participant's detail panel.
console.duplicateEventHelp: Copies the forms, questions and participant types — but no registrations. The copy starts as a draft, so check the dates before publishing.
console.duplicateEventSlugTaken: That name is already in use. Try a different one.

profile.title: My profile
profile.namePromptRequired: Please enter your first and last name.
profile.themeHelp: Choose light or dark, or follow your device.
profile.updateError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
profile.warnUnsaved: Warn me before leaving unsaved work
profile.warnUnsavedHelp: When editing an event's settings, page or forms, ask for confirmation before navigating away with changes that haven't been saved or published.
profile.formatPromptIntro: How should dates and times look? You can change this anytime in your profile.
profile.welcomeNameIntro: Add your name so organizers know who you are. You can change it later in your profile.

email.confirmIntro: Thank you for registering! Below are your registration details:
email.statusSubjectConfirmed: Great news! You are confirmed for {eventName}
email.statusLine: Your registration status for {eventName} has been updated to: {status}.
email.waitlistPromoted: You have been moved from the waitlist and your spot is now confirmed!
email.roleInviteSubject: You've been invited to Mosaic as a {roleName}
email.roleGrantedSubject: You've been added as a {roleName} on Mosaic
email.roleInviteBody: You have been invited to join Mosaic Events as a {roleName}. Sign in once to activate your access — your role will be applied automatically, and you'll be able to manage events from the organizer console.
email.roleGrantedBody: You have been added as a {roleName} for Mosaic Events. You now have access to manage events from the organizer console.
email.roleQuestions: If you have questions, please reach out to your event administrator.
email.automated: This is an automated message from Mosaic.

checkin.title: On-site check-in
checkin.noAccess: You do not have check-in access for this event.
checkin.cameraDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings, or use the search below.
checkin.manualHint: No ticket at hand? Find the participant by name.
checkin.ticketNoAccess: This is a participant's ticket. Ask an event organizer to check it in.
checkin.ticketSignInHint: Event staff can sign in to check this ticket in.
